Game Overview

Clouds and Sheep 2 puts players into a animal experience centered on be the shepherd in a whimsical world where fluffy sheep and fluid clouds harmoniously coexist. Cultivate happiness by nurturing your flock, creating storm clouds for rain, and expanding their paradise. Each playful interaction with your woolly friends unlocks new possibilities, making every moment a delight.
